seo.title: New employee welcome
seo.seo_description: New employee welcome: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what is left to validate with your adviser.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Accueil d'une nouvelle personne salariée », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: New employee welcome.
translation.subheadline: The New employee welcome template prepares the warm welcome email and a two-part preparation list: what the company prepares (workstation, access, access card, employment contract) and what the person brings (identity documents, social insurance number, direct deposit, TD1 and TP-1015.3-V forms).

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The New employee welcome template prepares the warm welcome email and a two-part preparation list: what the company prepares (workstation, access, access card, employment contract) and what the person brings (identity documents, social insurance number, direct deposit, TD1 and TP-1015.3-V forms). It starts from the first name, the position and the arrival date and place.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The first name. The person's first name.
  • The position. Position and department.
  • The arrival. Arrival date and place.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Prepare the welcome.
cards.text: An agent writes the welcome email, then a two-part list: "À préparer par l'entreprise" (workstation, access, access card, employment contract, payroll enrolment) and "À apporter par le salarié" (identity documents, social insurance number, bank details for direct deposit, TD1 and TP-1015.3-V withholding forms). It ends with "Documents de paie à valider par votre conseiller."

cards.title: Review.
cards.text: You read the text produced, correct it if needed, then use or send it yourself: the template sends nothing.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The lists are generic: add what is specific to your company. The TD1 and TP-1015.3-V withholding forms are only named, without any check: the payroll documents are to be validated by your adviser.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a Quebec small business: amounts in Canadian dollars, GST and QST wherever a tax applies, and Quebec business vocabulary. They do not guarantee any tax or legal compliance: the examples are fictional, and your accountant or adviser validates the result before use.

cards.title: Nothing is sent.
cards.text: The template produces text to review. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Does this template send anything for me?
items.answer: No. It produces text to review; you use or send it yourself. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

items.question: Does the email go to the person?
items.answer: No. The template produces the text and the list; you review them and send them yourself.

items.question: Is it suited to a Quebec employer?
items.answer: It is written for a Quebec employer, with fictional examples. The document list is not a guarantee of compliance: have the payroll and hiring documents validated by your adviser.

blocks.role: Appel à l'action : démonstration sur données fictives.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
